title: 第21章 人有所求第22章 欲望之争
slug: 苟住开局长生修仙只是副业
content_zh:
也对！
陈相家的事情，谁敢在这里多说什么？！
方司狱迎娶了陈相家的八小姐，那就是陈相的女婿，身份上一步登天，那些御史，都要躲着方司狱走，谁敢多说半句！
只可惜了方夫人……
识人不明！
竟然选择嫁给了方司狱这种人？！
连一年时间都等不及……
真是一个小人！
林铭心中想着，面上顺势点头说道：
“那这么说来，我们又要换一位头了？！也不知道两位校尉大人能不能再进一步？！”
雷校尉和陈校尉，是天牢之中，仅次于司狱的大人物了！
他们两人也都是牟足劲，想要成为司狱的存在！
只是能不能成为司狱，可不看他们，而看上面人的一句话！
以往十任天牢司狱，包括死在京都之乱的那一位，五五分，五位是上面直接空降下来的，还有五位是他们天牢之中提拔起来的，方司狱就是空降的！
“哎！”
方大厨轻叹一声，点了点头说道：
“希望是雷校尉或者是陈校尉其中的一位吧，毕竟一起在天牢之中这么长时间，他们什么脾性，我都清楚得很，这给方司狱的分润，直接转给他们，他们也不会再动我这个位置！要是来了一个新的校尉，也不知道胃口是比方司狱大还是比方司狱小？！”
“你不知道？！”
林铭有些诧异。
“嘿嘿！”

方大厨苦笑着摇了摇头。
“林狱卒，你该不会以为我是万事通？！什么都知道吧？！我也就是聚会的时候能多打听打听，这天下的事情那么多，我们这些厨子所知道的也都是一些听来的零散消息，而且还是两三天左右一次，我哪里能知道得那么详尽？！”
“也是……”
林铭点了点头，赞同着：
“方大厨，你能够知道这些，已经很不错了，比我是强了太多！”
“那是林狱卒你低调，我可听人说，你现在练了一身好本领，雷校尉耍牌的时候，还当众夸赞过你，说你的修炼进度之快，他都看走了眼，未来说不定你会是天牢第二位真气外放的高手……你有这个本领在身，想要打听什么消息？！牢内哪个兄弟会不给你面子？！”
方大厨这一句话，让林铭不由一惊！
他原本以为自己已经足够低调了！
可现在看来，还是不够……
武道境界，在有心之人的查看之下，还是能够看得清清楚楚！
自己这么短的时间内，就成为了内气大成的高手，雷校尉既然知道了，那其他人有没有可能知道？！
会不会探查一下自己这段时间当差之中所缺少的江湖人士？！
万一……
不行！
看样子，我要抓紧先将溶骨粉弄出来，到那尸坑之中，先将那些尸骨融化掉，死无对证，就算是再有什么人有疑心，也没什么可说的。
另外……
这每天一人的频率，也适当放缓一些。
改成三五天一人！
content_en:
That’s right!
Who dares to say anything here about the affairs of Mr. Chen’s family? !
Fang Siyu married the eighth lady of Chen Xiang's family, who was the son-in-law of Chen Xiang. His status rose to the top. Those censors all wanted to avoid Fang Siyu. Who dared to say a word?
It's a pity Mrs. Fang...
I don’t know people well!
You actually chose to marry someone like Fang Siyu? !
Can't even wait for a year...
What a villain!
Lin Ming thought in his mind, nodded his head and said:
"So, we have to change heads again?! I don't know if the two captains can go further?!"
Lieutenant Lei and Lieutenant Chen are the most important figures in the prison, second only to the prison chief!
Both of them are also very ambitious and want to become the prison chief!
Whether you can become a prison chief depends not on them, but on the words of the people above you!
In the past ten Tianlao Prisoners, including the one who died in the Kyoto Rebellion, 50-50, five were airborne directly from above, and five were promoted from their Heavenly Prisons. Fang Siyu was airborne!
"Hey!"
Chef Fang sighed softly, nodded and said:
"I hope it's one of Captain Lei or Lieutenant Chen. After all, I've been in the prison together for so long, and I know their temperaments very well. The profit share given to Fang Siyu will be transferred directly to them, and they won't touch my position again! If a new captain comes, I don't know if his appetite is bigger or smaller than that of Fang Siyu?!"
"You don't know?!"
Lin Ming was a little surprised.
"Hey!"
Chef Fang smiled bitterly and shook his head.
"Warder Lin, don't you think I know everything?! I know everything, right?! I just want to ask more questions during the party. There are so many things in the world, and all we cooks know are scattered information we heard, and it only happens once every two or three days. How can I know such detailed information?!"
"Also..."
Lin Ming nodded and agreed:
"Chef Fang, you are already very good at knowing this. You are much better than me!"
"That's because you are keeping a low profile, Jailer Lin. I have heard people say that you have developed a good skill now. When Lieutenant Lei was playing cards, he even praised you in public and said that your cultivation progress was so fast. He even missed it. In the future, you might be the second master in Tianluo who can unleash your true energy... You have this skill, what news do you want to know?! Which brother in the prison will not give you face?!"
Chef Fang's words made Lin Ming shocked!
He originally thought he was low-key enough!
But now it seems that it is still not enough...
The realm of martial arts can still be seen clearly under the inspection of a caring person!
He has become a master of inner energy in such a short period of time. Now that Lieutenant Lei knows, is it possible for others to know? !
Will he check out the people in the world that he lacks during this period of time? !
Just in case...
No!
It seems that I have to hurry up and get the bone-melting powder out first, go to the corpse pit, and melt the bones first. There is no evidence of death. Even if anyone is suspicious, there will be nothing to say.
Also…
The frequency of one person per day should be appropriately slowed down.
Change it to one person every three to five days!
